ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the backend health path, request timeout and the admin-route flag are declared; it does not probe a live balancer.
offer: Route only healthy backends with bounded request handling. Administrative routes remain outside the public ingress surface.

minimal.reason: Declare the backend health path. The balancer cannot drop unhealthy backends without it, so give the endpoint it polls.

mid.reason: Set the request timeout to at least 5000 ms. A shorter timeout cuts off legitimate slow requests, so bound it deliberately.

maximal.reason: Set exposing an admin route to false. Administrative routes on the public ingress invite takeover, so keep them internal.
